**Design is fixed and all tests pass.**

The bug was in the pointer update logic on line 48. According to the spec, after granting requester `i`, the pointer should advance to `(i + 1) mod 4` to give that requester the lowest priority in the next cycle. The original code was setting `ptr <= idx` (the currently granted requester), which prevented proper round-robin rotation. Changing it to `ptr <= idx + 1` fixes the issue—the 2-bit addition naturally wraps around (3 + 1 = 0), implementing the modulo 4 correctly.
